topics.label: Welcome and Lecture Framing
topics.groupedBecause: It introduces the lecture's scope, learning outcomes, and foundational context on cancer evolution and microenvironmental interactions.

topics.label: Genetic and Epigenetic Drivers of Clonal Selection
topics.groupedBecause: They explain how both progressive mutational acquisition and non-mutational epigenetic reprogramming confer competitive fitness advantages to drive clonal evolution.

topics.label: Cell of Origin and Cancer Stem Cell Models
topics.groupedBecause: They evaluate the hierarchical and stochastic models of cancer, assessing evidence from leukemia and colorectal systems for whether malignancies initiate within stem cells or committed progenitors.

topics.label: Environmental and Inflammatory Promotion in Early Tumorigenesis
topics.groupedBecause: They demonstrate through lung and colon cancer models how chronic inflammation and environmental exposures provide necessary promotional signals that activate stem-like states in mutated cells.

topics.label: Established Microenvironmental Dependencies, Profiling Technologies, and Evolutionary Synthesis
topics.groupedBecause: They examine stromal support in established tumors, the spatial and single-cell profiling techniques used to analyze these communities, and synthesize how microenvironments coevolve with malignant clones.

topics.label: Closing Remarks and Next Lecture
topics.groupedBecause: It concludes the session and previews the topic of cancer therapeutics for the upcoming lecture.
